description: How to reach one subhandle of the repository's account directly. Record key: the subhandle. Read with one getRecord(DID, computer.socialweb.peer, subhandle); never listed. A reader trusts the record only while the identlink walk of the repository DID reaches the owner: every grant unexpired and its contract Held. A stale record whose walk no longer reaches the owner is ignored.

iroh.description: A short iroh ticket (node id and relay, no addresses) whose endpoint serves this account's XRPC directly.

webrtc.description: The DID whose repo answers computer.socialweb.ingress.offer records for this account.

channels.description: The atirc channels the subhandle is in.
